title.value: An Empirical Study of Data Access Self-Admitted Technical Debt
title.justification: The title of the paper clearly states the focus on data access and self-admitted technical debt.
title.quote: An Empirical Study of Data Access Self-Admitted Technical Debt

extractions.description: The paper presents a large-scale empirical study on the prevalence, composition, and evolution of self-admitted technical debt (SATD) in data-intensive systems, analyzing both relational and NoSQL databases. It identifies new SATD categories specific to database access operations and investigates the reasons behind their introduction and removal.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on technical debt in data-intensive systems, which is primarily a software engineering concern. While efficient data management can indirectly contribute to sustainability, it's not a central theme of the paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We present a large-scale empirical study on the prevalence, composition, and evolution of SATD in data-intensive systems

primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on software engineering and technical debt, not directly on Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development.
